svg.title: E3 serious-underprediction pilot: eligible configurations only
svg.desc: Two heatmaps for background spectra t=0 and t=0.8. Only cells whose 95 percent risk confidence interval lies entirely above 0.10 are colored. Values show frequency of plug-in predictions at or below 0.05. Other cells are explicitly marked.
svg.text: Only where the lower 95% confidence limit for population risk R exceeds 0.10
E3 exploratory pilot · d = 12, k = 3 · 1,000 replications per configuration
— Ineligible (risk CI below threshold) ? Uncertain eligibility (risk CI crosses threshold)
